P1 — The uniqueness proof uses false graph and bottleneck identities — Counterevidence: Empirical useful fits remain possible; stronger global identification assumptions could alter theorem

P1 — The uniqueness proof uses false graph and bottleneck identities — Counterevidence: The path example is an acyclic connected full graph, so cycle exclusion cannot rescue the sign/count identity. Repeated finite bars are a diagnostic of the asserted metric identity, not a complete counterexample to the final neural optimization theorem; essential bars require a separately specified convention. Empirical utility is not contradicted. A different global identification assumption could repair the first implication, but does not repair the later independent identities.

P2 — Rational Hat vectorization lacks required bottleneck Lipschitz property — Counterevidence: Pointwise smoothness or empirical usefulness does not imply diagram-space Lipschitz; restricted domain might support a different bound

P2 — Rational Hat vectorization lacks required bottleneck Lipschitz property — Counterevidence: For actual one-Lipschitz witnesses, any coupling bounds the absolute expectation difference by its expected cost; Proposition3.3 itself is sound. Pointwise smoothness, fixed batch tensors, and empirical usefulness do not imply diagram stability under near-diagonal insertion/deletion. A restricted finite diagram domain could admit another constant but no such restriction is stated. Two identical valid witnesses can each attain distance d, making their unnormalized sum2d; two-head selection alone is not a one-Lipschitz normalization.
P3 — Wrong closest diagonal point in bottleneck definition — Counterevidence: Likely local definition typo; code uses PH backend rather than direct printed matching formula

P3 — Wrong closest diagonal point in bottleneck definition — Counterevidence: The inspected release computes persistent representations via a backend rather than directly implementing the printed partial-matching formula. No historical metric computation using the typo was established. Therefore the isolated definition repair is Minor; its severity is not discounted merely because it is in an appendix.
